items.name: Rémy Menu
items.description: Starter and Main Course. Starters: mixed salad, young Cantal cheese, black olives, truffle ham chiffonade and garden-herb vinaigrette; seasonal soup with The Laughing Cow® and mixed herbs; pear, chestnut and duck pâté en croûte, fig marmalade; or green lentil salad with carrot julienne, cherry tomatoes and Greek-style plant-based cubes, garden-herb vinaigrette (veggie). Main courses: grilled steak, french fries (choice of sauce: Café de Paris sauce, green peppercorns, brie or béarnaise); roast cod, crushed potatoes with beurre blanc sauce; vegetable blanquette with sliced soy and pea protein (veggie); or roasted chicken supreme, baby potatoes, mushrooms and mushroom-flavoured sauce

items.name: Émile Menu
items.description: Starter, Main Course and Dessert. Starters and main courses as the Rémy Menu. Desserts: Brie de Meaux cheese, raisins, soft apricots; chocolate mousse; fruit salad; lemon meringue tart; fromage blanc-raspberry entremet; or Gusteau's dessert

items.name: Flight of 3 wines (3 x 8 cl)
items.description: To accompany your meal, from our selection: AOP Côtes de Provence - Minuty - Prestige rosé 8 cl; AOP Sancerre - Château de Sancerre - Sauvignon blanc 8 cl or Edition Bistrot Chez Rémy - AOC Saint-Emilion - Fleur de Roc 8 cl; Édition Spéciale Disneyland® Paris Champagne Pierre Mignon Grande Réserve - Brut 10 cl or AOC Sainte-Croix-du-Mont - Château des Arroucats 8 cl (sweet wine)

items.name: Little Chef Menu
items.description: For children ages from 3 to 11. Starter, Main Course, Dessert and Drink. Starters: carrot soup (veggie) or charcuterie plate, vegetable crisps and The Laughing Cow® cheese. Main courses: chicken fillet, fries, cheese cream sauce; Linguine Bolognese or Linguine with tomato sauce (veggie); or roast cod, crushed potatoes, tomato sauce. Desserts: Rémy's eclair, fromage blanc with fruit (No Added Sugar), chocolate mousse or fruit salad. Drink: Vittel® 33 cl, orange or apple juice 25 cl or milk 20 cl. Or Disney Check Menu: carrot soup; Linguine Bolognese or Linguine with tomato sauce; fromage blanc with fresh fruit (No Added Sugar); Vittel® 33 cl. An alternative cold drink (25 cl) may replace a similar item on request

Starters: green pea velouté with okra fritter (vegan), rolled vegetable omelette with mayonnaise and pastrami or fish rillettes with smoked salmon and cocktail sauce; main courses: conchiglie pasta with ricotta cheese, red and yellow tomato sauce, haddock fillet with citrus sauce, yellow carrot purée and purple cauliflower or pulled chicken with buttery mashed potatoes, pan jus and toast strip; desserts: almond sponge cake with white chocolate mousse and blueberry centre, seasonal fruit tartlet with mascarpone mousse or milk chocolate mousse with caramelised puff pastry; drinks: Vittel® 33 cl, orange or apple juice 25 cl or milk 20 cl. Another cold drink 25cl is available upon request as a replacement for the product offered
